gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1189. PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following road will be known in future as described hereunder:— Headland Road (赫蘭道): Road to R.B.L. 508 commencing at Island Road at a point approximately 100 yds. North of the junction of Island and Chung Am Kok Roads, and running in a westerly and north westerly direction and terminating on the northern boundary of the lot between sites No. 10 and No. 11.
